text: Question: Why is my 4G/5G data speed slower than expected? Answer: ### Short Answer Speed can be affected by network congestion at peak hours, device compatibility with 5G bands, distance from the tower, indoor signal attenuation, or fair-usage throttling after crossing your plan's high-speed data quota. Run a speed test under Network > Speed Test to compare against your plan's expected range. ### Detailed Explanation The listed causes split into two kinds: environment/device-related (congestion, band compatibility, distance, indoor attenuation) which vary by location and handset, and plan-related (fair-usage throttling), which is specifically about having crossed your plan's high-speed data quota — the speed test exists to compare what you're actually getting against your plan's expected range, which helps tell the two kinds apart. ### Key Details | Detail | Value | |---|---| | Environment/device causes | Peak-hour congestion; device 5G-band compatibility; distance from tower; indoor signal attenuation | | Plan-related cause | Fair-usage throttling after crossing high-speed data quota | | Where to check | Network > Speed Test | ### Troubleshooting | Symptom | Possible Cause | Diagnostic Check | Recommended Action | |---|---|---|---| | Slow speed, high-speed data quota not yet used up | Congestion, distance from tower, indoor signal, or device band compatibility | Time of day, location (indoor/outdoor), device 5G band support | Run Network > Speed Test and compare to your plan's expected range | | Slow speed, high-speed data quota already exceeded | Fair Usage Policy throttling | Data usage against plan's high-speed allowance
title: Why is my 4G/5G data speed slower than expected?
